title: Here’s what I know: if it were really the end of the world, nobody would have to tell you. 🤔

caption:
Here’s what I know: if it were really the end of the world, nobody would have to tell you. 🤔

So if fear is holding you back, flip it. ↩️

Let it push you into action:

“I need to get busy. I don’t have time to keep waiting.”

Because I would rather try and find out it didn’t work than never try and wonder if it would have worked. 🎯

Fear can warn you. But it does not have to run your life.

What would you try this week if you stopped making every risk feel final? ❓❓❓
